title: NBA Guidelines on Access to Biological Resources and Benefit Sharing Regulations 2014
content: The Guidelines on Access to Biological Resources and Associated Knowledge and Benefits Sharing Regulations, 2014 provide the regulatory framework and percentage calculations for benefit sharing payments payable to NBA or State Biodiversity Boards (SBB). For commercial utilization of bio-resources by Indian entity or trader, the benefit sharing obligation ranges from 0.1% to 0.5% of annual gross ex-factory sales depending on turnover slab: 0.1% for sales up to Rs. 1 Crore, 0.2% for sales between Rs. 1 Crore and 3 Crores, and 0.5% for sales exceeding Rs. 3 Crores. When IPR is granted for an invention based on biological resources, the applicant/holder shall pay benefit sharing ranging from 0.2% to 1.0% of gross ex-factory sales or 3.0% to 5.0% of royalty received if the IPR is licensed or assigned to a third party.
